resources.string: Isimo sokuqoshwa nesilinganiso sokushaya kwenhliziyo akusona isifo esixilongiwe. Udokotela ogunyaziwe kufanele ahlole umbiko oqediwe.
Qala ngokubhangqa i-%1$s nge-Bluetooth, bese uzama ukudlulisa okuqoshiwe futhi. Ukubhangqa nge-Bluetooth kuhlukile ekuvunyweni komhlengikazi.
Ukudluliswa kokuqoshiwe akuphelanga. Hlola uxhumano lwedivayisi bese uzama futhi. Okuqoshiwe okulindile kugciniwe.
Uhlelo lokunakekelwa alukwazanga ukugcinwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
Igagasi elilodwa; ubukhulu abukalinganiselwa ukusetshenziswa kwezokwelapha; ubude besikhathi %1$s

resources.string: Swayipha ukuze ubuke okuqoshiwe. Usayizi obonisiwe awusona isilinganiso esiqinisekisiwe sezokwelapha.
Ukufundwa ngezwi akutholakali ngalolu limi. Hlola amazwi afakiwe kuzilungiselelo ze-Android zokufunda umbhalo ngezwi. Umbhalo usesekhona esikrinini.
Ungathi: vula ikhaya, vula ukubukeka, vula ulimi, buyela emuva, noma thula.
